reviews.reviewText: Paper was very logical and conceptual. It felt like a PhD level economics paper. Examples were confusing.

Paper 31 January 10:00 AM ko tha. MCQs zyada tar Eco401 final term past paper solved video (Title: 'Eco401 final term past paper solved mcqs 2023 to 2026||eco 401 most important mcqs for spring 2026 final term exams', Channel: 'Educational Tips') se aaye (2023–2026) aur kuch formulas aur conceptually muskil MCQs bhi poochay gaye. Price discrimination se 4 MCQs aaye.

Video se MCQs kaafi cover hue (Title: 'Eco401 final term past paper solved mcqs 2023 to 2026||eco 401 most important mcqs for spring 2026 final term exams', Channel: 'Educational Tips') aur baki MCQs handouts aur formulas se aaye. Formulas aur conceptual questions thode challenging thay, lekin video ne concepts ko clear kar diya. Overall paper manageable aur preparation videos important rahe.
